item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Read SPEC.md in the repository first. Implement safe_extract.py so that it matches the documented API exactly and handles every error and boundary case the spec lists. Extend the test suite with focused tests for each specified error and boundary case, beyond the existing basic tests. Use only the Python standard library. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate inputs at the boundary, never swallow errors, and keep path-traversal, absolute-path, symlink and archive-bomb style protections explicit if the spec requires them. Run the full test suite and make sure it passes. Commit the work on the item's branch with a plain commit message and no tool attribution lines.

state.summary:
Implemented safe_extract.extract per SPEC.md and extended test_safe_extract.py with 45 focused tests (47 total, including the 2 original basics). Batch validation runs in full before any filesystem write: non-list batches, malformed entries, names, data, duplicates and file/directory collisions in either order, root checks, symlinks, dangling links, existing targets and file ancestors. Writes happen only after validation, use exclusive 'xb' creation, and unexpected I/O errors propagate. Stdlib only. Final full check at head 93980e7 (tree 29a6b51): `python3 -m unittest` 47 tests OK. Three reviewers read the whole change at 6d6a7b7 and passed it (no blocking findings). A delta reviewer read 6d6a7b7..93980e7 and passed the branch head. Non-blocking follow-ups, not fixed: lone-surrogate names are accepted and written as raw bytes; over-long names raise OSError during validation rather than ValueError and are untested; the check-then-write path is not TOCTOU-safe (out of scope per spec); the case-insensitive filesystem collision case is not covered. Nothing is pushed. No processes were started by this stage.
REVIEW: pass by review-1, review-2, review-3 and review-delta.

evidence.none: Library code with no visible or measurable change; outcome is shown by the unit test suite.

pr.body: Approach: extract() snapshots the batch once, validates the whole batch (entry shape, names, data type, duplicate and file/directory collisions), validates the root (real directory, not a symlink) and every target path (no symlink or non-directory ancestor, target absent) with lstat, then writes with exclusive 'xb' creation, creating missing parents. Files: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Checks: unittest 47 OK at head 93980e7. Reviews: three whole-change reviews passed at 6d6a7b7, delta review passed at 93980e7. Assumptions: entries must be exact tuples of length 2; list subclasses are accepted. Limits: no TOCTOU protection (out of spec scope); lone-surrogate names accepted; over-long names raise OSError during validation (untested).
pr.summary: made safe extract happen. now can write a validated batch of regular files under an existing root, rejecting any unsafe batch before touching disk. before: extract was a NotImplementedError stub with 2 basic tests; now: 47 tests covering each spec rule, all passing.
pr.title: Implement safe extract with batch validation and focused tests

risk.why: Writes files under a caller-supplied root and makes path-validation decisions (traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, overwrite). Reviewers confirmed high. Tests run: 47 OK.
